summary: Alter Games' World War II stealth tactics and survival-management game about Soviet partisans behind enemy lines.

entries.title: Partisans 1941
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with Back Into Battle DLC

primary.version: Windows PC release with Back Into Battle DLC
primary.why: Partisans 1941 is Windows-only, and the Steam Extended Edition route includes the Back Into Battle DLC with additional missions/challenge content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version and include Back Into Battle if covering the complete mission/challenge set.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows tactical RPG/real-time tactics release with DLC support.
all_releases.reason: primary: only documented platform and complete route with Back Into Battle.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows is the only documented release platform.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster; Back Into Battle adds missions/challenge content rather than a separate story sequel.
